game.title: Destiny 2
game.blurb: Online first-person shooter with campaigns and shared-world activities, from Bungie, released 2017-09-06. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Vanguard Ops on Master and Grandmaster

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 1085660 is used; its list has only 23 achievements, 3 of them hidden, so this is a thin skeleton for a large live game. Red War and Forsaken are named because achievement descriptions name them; other expansion and season names (for example Shadowkeep, Beyond Light, Lightfall and The Final Shape on the Fandom page list) have no achievements and no chapters. StrategyWiki has no page under "Destiny 2" or "Destiny". destinypedia.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; destiny.fandom.com has "Destiny 2" with about 123 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam data does not say whether "The Corrupted" and "Warden of Nothing" are strikes or other activities, so they sit with the Ops chapter where their achievement puts them.
